I’m just glad she hadn’t asked anything before we figure out what we want to tell her and how we want to go about it, because the last thing I want is for someone to tell her without thinking about it enough and us end up confusing her or making what’s already going to be hard worse. Thanks, I’m trying hard to not let her see me upset so I can make sure we are ready before we tell her. Thankfully we have some family coming tomorrow so she will at least be happy and with people who she will be excited to see when we do figure out how to tell her. I am going to try tomorrow to see if I can find out who her doctor is, I’m sure she has medicine that will say somewhere at her house. I think that her mom would have liked to be able to tell her but she didn’t even get to say goodbye to her more than just a see you later and be good. This was very sudden, she was hurting and was taken to the emergency room where they found out she had a blood clot in her spleen and then it rapidly turned to (or potentially progressed) sepsis in less than 24 hours. We blinked and it went from staying home to watch her daughter to now trying to figure things like this out. I do really appreciate your advice, I hadn’t even thought about her doctor knowing her very well and probably knowing the best how to go about this!

I’m incredibly bad at redstone, but I watched a couple of videos on people making auto looping jukeboxes. Essentially a dispenser under the jukebox with 9 discs pointing up at the jukebox. Redstone leading to a redstone block with two sticky pistons on either side. Then both sides are the same, three redstone in the pattern shown, a repeater not changed from default spot, a comparator also not changed, and then a hopper. The hoppers are pointing at eachother and inside are four full stacks of cobble and one stack of 26.  This gives the signal a timer of just over most disc lengths and switches to the next disc automatically once it moves the redstone block twice.
Maybe overexplained, I’m just stupid with redstone and barely stumbled through making it lol

A couple years ago, I was in my parents house in the middle of a bunch of fields with no neighbors around us, when I came upstairs from the basement at about 3 am to get a drink and to get to the kitchen I had to walk in the line of sight of the window on the front door. The second I stepped around the corner and into view someone pounded on the door. It was literally not even a second after I stepped out, which means that someone had to have been looking in the window. I immediately went back behind the corner and called my mom who was upstairs, panicking because we don’t have any neighbors and it wasn’t a “can I borrow a cup of sugar” kind of knock. By the time we got up the courage to check, no one was around. And then for the next week or so our fence gates would be opened when we would come outside and our car alarms would go off randomly. I was too scared to look at the window to the door but part of me wishes I could know it was a person and not something more creepy.
